story: Four riders formed the early breakaway in Stage 2 of Paris–Nice, but only Mathis Le Berre and Casper Pedersen remained after the first climb. The leaders were caught with 60 km to go. Daan Hoole attacked solo with 21 km left but was caught in the final kilometer. Max Kanter won the bunch sprint ahead of Laurence Pithie and Jasper Stuyven.
